## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — see the DCO section in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and the affected module's test suite passes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` entry added — or not applicable (refactor / formatting / test-only / deps)
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed (module `README.md` and/or `documentation/vitepress/`)
- [ ] The change follows the style of the surrounding code
